critique: The upward-accreting carved storeys, impossible cantilever bridges, drifting moth, and ochre–pāua glow create a bold, atmospheric fusion of organic whakairo rhythms and generative architecture. The rigid, densely ornamented border competes with the tower’s silhouette, while the tiny guinea-pig easter egg feels visually unintegrated; simplify the frame and weave the moth or mist into the carvings themselves so the cyber-nature fusion becomes structural rather than decorative.
